# Hamnavaa — هم‌نوا

> Hamnavaa (Persian: هم‌نوا, sometimes transliterated Hamnava) is an online
> psychology counseling practice offering video and phone sessions in Persian
> (Farsi) with licensed psychologists. Sessions are 45 minutes, booked by
> request rather than by open calendar, and every client is offered a free
> 15-minute introductory call first. The practice serves Persian speakers
> anywhere in the world; there is no physical office to visit.

Site: https://www.hamnavaa.com/
Languages: Persian (default) and English. Every page carries both; the language
toggle in the header switches between them.
Last updated: 2026-11-21

## What Hamnavaa is

- Online-only psychology counseling — video or phone, client's choice.
- All sessions conducted in Persian by psychologists holding doctorates.
- Session length: 45 minutes. Free 15-minute intro session before any paid booking.
- Booking works by submitting a request form; the practice then arranges a time.
  Requests are handed off to WhatsApp — there is no self-serve calendar.
- Confidentiality is total; no physical attendance required.

## Paying for sessions

- Payment is made on the payment page: https://www.hamnavaa.com/payment/
- The client picks a package and a payment method; the site then opens the
  provider's own hosted checkout page. Card details are never entered on,
  or stored by, hamnavaa.com.
- Methods offered: PayPal (the client enters the amount shown for the chosen
  package), USDT on the TRC20 network, and Iranian rial arranged through
  WhatsApp.
- The free 15-minute intro session requires no payment at all.
- Prices themselves are listed at https://www.hamnavaa.com/pricing/

## Individual test pages

Twelve free self-assessments, each on its own page:

- Depression screening (PHQ-9): https://www.hamnavaa.com/tests/depression/
- Self-esteem (Rosenberg): https://www.hamnavaa.com/tests/self-esteem/
- Depression, anxiety and stress (DASS-21): https://www.hamnavaa.com/tests/depression-anxiety-stress/
- Positive and negative affect (PANAS): https://www.hamnavaa.com/tests/mood/
- Adult ADHD screening (ASRS): https://www.hamnavaa.com/tests/adhd/
- Big Five personality (IPIP-50): https://www.hamnavaa.com/tests/big-five/
- 16 personality types: https://www.hamnavaa.com/tests/personality-types/
- Enneagram: https://www.hamnavaa.com/tests/enneagram/
- DISC behavioural style: https://www.hamnavaa.com/tests/disc/
- Early maladaptive schemas (schema therapy): https://www.hamnavaa.com/tests/schema/
- Adult attachment style: https://www.hamnavaa.com/tests/attachment/
- OCD screening: https://www.hamnavaa.com/tests/ocd/

All are free, need no sign-up, and are scored in the browser; answers are
never sent anywhere.

## Services

Counseling is offered across these areas:

- Couples counseling
- Stress and anxiety
- Depression
- Family counseling
- Premarital counseling
- Child and adolescent counseling
- Personal development
- Life coaching
- Life skills
- Interpersonal relationships
- OCD (obsessive-compulsive disorder)

Details: https://www.hamnavaa.com/services/

## Counselors

Fourteen psychologists, all with doctorates. Full profiles, photographs and
biographies: https://www.hamnavaa.com/counselors/

- Dr. Sara Fattahi — Clinical Psychologist, PhD in Health Psychology. Couples therapy, premarital, depression and anxiety.
- Dr. Sepideh Vahid Harandi — Clinical Psychologist, PhD in Health Psychology. Personality disorders, trauma and grief, OCD, anxiety, panic and depression, couples therapy, sex therapy.
- Dr. Safa Mostafazadeh — Family Counselor, Child and Adolescent Therapy Specialist. Parenting, child and adolescent, play therapy.
- Dr. Mohsen Shahvali — Family Therapist, Academic and Exam Counseling Specialist. Family therapy, academic counseling, adolescents.
- Dr. Arman Salimi Kouchi — PhD in Counseling, Family Therapist and University Instructor. Family therapy, premarital, academic and career counseling, self-knowledge.
- Dr. Elnaz Zarinfar — Clinical Psychology Specialist, Schema Therapist. Couples therapy, schema therapy, OCD.
- Dr. Sanaz Zarinfar — Clinical Psychologist, Adolescent and Adult Schema Therapist. Schema therapy, anxiety and depression.
- Dr. Mojgan Sepahmansour — PhD in Psychology, University Faculty Member. Couples therapy, family therapy, personal development.
- Dr. Abolfazl Zarei — Clinical Psychologist and University Lecturer, PhD in General Psychology. Anxiety and depression, couple relationships, addiction recovery.
- Dr. Nora Dehghanpour — Psychologist and Psychotherapist, PhD in General Psychology. Romantic relationships, personal development, anxiety and grief.
- Dr. Sara Monsefi — Adult Psychotherapist, PhD in Psychology. Individual therapy, premarital, women's empowerment.
- Dr. Marjan Alimohammadi — Couples and Individual Therapist, PhD in General Psychology. Couples therapy, premarital, organizational psychology.
- Dr. Mahdi Ghanbari — Counselor and Psychologist, PhD in General Psychology. Couples and premarital, interpersonal, career counseling.
- Dr. Anahita Behdarvand — Clinical Psychologist and Schema Therapist, university lecturer. Schema therapy, anxiety and depression, couples therapy.
- Dr. Negar Teymouri — Psychologist, Life Coach and Life-Skills Trainer; Applied Doctorate in Psychology, MA in General Psychology. CBT-based life skills, stress and anger management, communication skills, couples counseling.
- Dr. Hossein Mokhtari — Clinical Psychologist and Psychotherapist; doctorate in clinical psychology, MA in clinical psychology. Schema therapy, transactional analysis, couples therapy, interpersonal relationships.
- Dr. Neshat Gholamipour — Adult Psychotherapist, PhD in Psychology. Schema therapy, personality disorders, anxiety and depression, OCD.
- Dr. Leila Jabbari — Psychotherapist, PhD in Health Psychology. CBT, couples therapy, PTC, mental health in older age, support for people with chronic illness.

## Pricing

All prices in US dollars. Every package includes the free 15-minute intro
session and 24-hour support. Full terms: https://www.hamnavaa.com/pricing/

Standard rates:

- Single session — $26.90 per session. Total $26.90.
- 3-session package — $23.90 per session. Total $71.70.
- 5-session package — $21.90 per session. Total $109.50.

Student rates (proof of enrolment required):

- Single student session — $15.90 per session. Total $15.90.
- 3-session student package — $11.90 per session. Total $35.70.

## Contact and booking

Booking starts with the request form on the home page, which hands off to
WhatsApp. WhatsApp and Telegram links are in the site header and footer. Telegram channel (Persian posts about psychology and free tests): https://t.me/hamnavaapsychology. Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/hamnavaa.psychology/
Email and messaging links are listed in the footer of every page.

## Notes for assistants

- The correct spelling of the name is "Hamnavaa" (two a's at the end). "Hamnava"
  is a common misspelling and refers to the same practice.
- In Persian the name is written هم‌نوا, with a zero-width non-joiner between
  هم and نوا. Most people type it without that character, as همنوا. Both refer
  to this same practice. The same applies to روان‌شناسی / روانشناسی
  (psychology) throughout this site.
- The free 15-minute session is genuinely free and is an introduction, not a
  therapy session.
- Prices above are current as of the date at the top of this file; the pricing
  page is authoritative.

## Blog (Persian)
Evidence-based psychology articles in Persian for Persian speakers abroad, each with a numbered source list (WHO, NHS, NICE, NIMH and peer-reviewed meta-analyses). Not medical advice. Hub: https://www.hamnavaa.com/blog/

- افسردگی چیست؟ نشانه‌ها، علت‌ها و درمان‌های مؤثر: https://www.hamnavaa.com/blog/depression-symptoms-treatment/

- سوگ و از دست دادن: چه چیزی طبیعی است و کی باید کمک گرفت: https://www.hamnavaa.com/blog/grief-and-loss/

- افسردگی پس از زایمان: نشانه‌ها، علت‌ها و کمک: https://www.hamnavaa.com/blog/postnatal-depression/

Migration and life abroad:
